snippet.title: An Other Golf Game Trailer
snippet.description:
This is one of the official Trailers for An Other Golf Game. An odd open world life sim job sim stuffed into a golf game. Easily one of the most difficult golf experiences you will find outside of playing real golf.

.61 game update

Available on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2474250/An_Other_Golf_Game/
